body.heading: Purpose
body.text:
Our food system is broken. Currently, it is the primarly driver for the transgeression of our planetary boundaries. In Finland alone, 1.1 tons of edible food is thrown away every day (Natural Resources Institute Finland). 

**Ultimately, the question is not whether we transition away from the current system but rather how and to where?**

 For the past 3 years, I have worked on food system change from the end of the value chain, focusing on the reduction of food waste through Aalto Foodsharing in Finland. We are an initiative at the intersection of community-led grassroots action, public awareness, and political advocacy. Our goal is to become a global movement in tackling food waste.

body.heading: Operations
body.text:
I am mainly responsible for overseeing, improving and expanding our day-to-day operations, including managing our volunteer network and relationships with food business partners.

This is where my background in service design becomes particularly relevant. I identify challenges and develope practical solutions to adress them. This involves, for example questions of: 

→  How can we improve the onboarding experience for new volunteers? 
→ How can we make the food pick-up process smoother and more efficient for both volunteers and food suppliers?
→ How can we better reach and engage new food business partners through, for example, tailored information materials and introductory packages? 
→ And how can we ensure that our community fridge spaces remain clean, accessible and well-maintained?

body.heading: Outreach & Advocacy
body.text: I also support with organizing and hosting of events for outreach and advocacy purposes. These include, for example, community dinner and cookouts, food system talks, workshop with experts on food conservation, pop-up food distributions or public activism actions. Further we enagage in various networks and with local actors to share our best practices and way of working and to advocate for systemic changes in food policy.
